content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Fonts online

Stripe and PayPal promise seamless payment processing for digital goods, yet they operate in only 46 countries out of 195 globally, leaving many creators stranded. A PayPal account suspension can freeze your funds for up to 180 days, effectively blocking access to earned income without any recourse. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure provides an alternative that eliminates dependence on these restrictive platforms. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments, you gain full control over your sales process, enabling you to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies without the risk of account suspension or financial isolation.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

PayPal and Stripe have strict geographical limitations that exclude a significant number of creators, particularly in developing nations. This exclusion isn't merely a choice; it's a structural limitation that reinforces a digital divide. Sovereign commerce infrastructure addresses this gap by offering creators the tools they need to operate independently of these restrictions. With COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy an online store that functions seamlessly in regions where conventional platforms fail, ensuring that your business is not at the mercy of corporate policies or geographical barriers.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

While PayPal and Stripe often advertise low transaction fees, the hidden costs of operating within their ecosystems can be staggering. Additionally, payment delays can significantly impact cash flow, especially for creators relying on timely income. In contrast, a sovereign commerce infrastructure has clear and manageable fees — with NOWPayments charging only 0.5% per transaction — and instant payment confirmations on-chain. This means you receive your revenue quickly, allowing you to reinvest in your business without the worry of held funds or unexpected charges.
Ownership of your digital products means no more account freezes.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With PayPal and Stripe, you’re subject to their terms of service and risk losing access to your funds at any moment. This precarious situation is eliminated with sovereign commerce infrastructure, where you maintain complete ownership of your digital products and customer data post-deployment. Systems like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 ensure secure file delivery while automating the payment verification process through NOWPayments. This architecture not only empowers you but also automates sales, ensuring customers receive their products instantly without manual intervention.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in regions where traditional payment processors are off-limits, moving to a sovereign commerce infrastructure is not just an option; it’s the only sensible choice. If you’re looking to sell fonts or other digital products, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is ideal for launching quickly with five products already loaded and 30 days of support. This setup protects you from the unpredictability of corporate platforms, allowing you to focus on creating and selling, rather than worrying about payment processing roadblocks.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Instant payment processing avoids the cash flow issues of traditional platforms.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by selecting the Edge Commerce Stack for a quick setup. Deploy your online store using Cloudflare Pages as your hosting solution. Configure a backend with Supabase to handle order storage. Integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Set up SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email security. Finally, test your entire system to ensure everything works seamlessly before launching.
